correctness.rationale: Plancherel in the unbounded modulation variable reduces the entire operator to multiplication by the explicit sliding-window function. The density is normalized and the primitive differentiates exactly. Positive outer critical points solve a strictly monotone coth equation; the optional inner valley solves a strictly concave tanh equation; all global candidates are exhausted. The central-minus-outer envelope increases strictly for all widths greater than one, giving the unique global crossing. A monotone-branch change-of-variable argument proves absolute continuity and two/four/six spectral multiplicities, including all width boundaries. The packaged checker reproduces roots, derivatives and branch counts but is not used to prove infinite claims.

Abreu–Speckbacher general-region Hermite-window concentration estimates do not give equalities or spectra for this unbounded strip.

value.rationale: The first Hermite intensity has a natural bimodal shape. The exact competition of center and displaced peaks resolves the optimal concentration constant for every strip width, distinguishes the local onset at width one from the later global jump, identifies a nondifferentiability, and determines the full continuous spectral multiplicity up to six. These natural invariants are not captured by standard general-region upper bounds or finite-dimensional Hermite-band concentration.
